entries.body: Mail, calendars and files run on Microsoft 365 Business Standard: 14 licensed staff accounts on marigoldfoodbank.example, plus two shared mailboxes, info@marigoldfoodbank.example and donations@marigoldfoodbank.example.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: Two accounts hold the Global Administrator role: the operations manager's daily account and the volunteer IT lead's account. No other admin roles are assigned.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: Microsoft 365 admin center role list read, Nov 4, 2026

entries.body: Security defaults are on for the tenant. No Conditional Access policies exist; the licence does not include them.
entries.label: VERIFIED

entries.body: Whether every staff account has finished registering a second sign-in factor under security defaults: the registration report has not been read.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: Sign-in is not blocked on either shared mailbox. donations@ has its own password, which three volunteers use to triage donor email on their personal phones.
entries.label: VERIFIED

entries.body: The donations@ mailbox shows failed sign-in attempts from two foreign countries between Oct 27 and Nov 3, 2026; no successful sign-in from outside the region is listed.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: donations@ recent sign-in list read, Nov 4, 2026

entries.body: Apps staff connected to Microsoft 365: the donor-management service (mail and calendar sync), the volunteer-scheduling app (sign-in with Microsoft), and an e-signature add-in a staff member installed for a grant agreement in 2025.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: The permissions those apps hold, who consented to them, and whether staff may consent to new apps on their own: not on record.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: Until June 2025 the tenant was administered by a managed IT provider under contract; its accounts were removed at handover. Which tools or integrations it connected to the tenant was never written down.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: The tenant's default alert policies are on. Their emails go to the operations manager's inbox, where a mail rule files them into a folder that is rarely opened.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: marigoldfoodbank.example is registered through the website host's bundled registrar, and the same host serves its DNS.
entries.label: VERIFIED

entries.body: MX points to Microsoft 365. SPF lists Microsoft 365 and the donor-management service's sending service.
entries.label: VERIFIED

entries.body: The registrar and hosting account is in the executive director's name; its login is shared with the operations manager.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: Whether the registrar and hosting account has two-step sign-in, and which address its recovery mail goes to.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: The public site runs on a managed WordPress host. Pages are edited through the CMS admin page; no code is deployed from a repository.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: page source and host control panel read, Nov 3, 2026

entries.body: SFTP is enabled on the hosting account with one shared login. Its password was set by the design agency that built the site in 2023 and has not changed since the handover.
entries.label: VERIFIED

entries.body: Five CMS administrator accounts exist: the web volunteer, the communications coordinator, the executive director, and two left over from the design agency.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: Whether any CMS administrator account has two-step sign-in.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: Donations go through the payment processor's hosted checkout page; card details never touch the website. The processor's card-testing protection, a challenge on repeated attempts, and a per-card attempt limit are on.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: test donation in the processor's test mode, Nov 4, 2026

entries.body: The processor emails the finance lead when daily donation or refund volume moves well outside its usual range, and a change to the payout bank account needs a second approver.
entries.label: VERIFIED

entries.body: The processor plugin's secret API key is stored on the plugin's settings page inside the CMS database. It was created in 2023 and has never been rotated.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: Requests for missing pages, a malformed search query and a broken donation-form submission each returned the host's plain error page, with no software versions, paths or database messages.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: error-page probe of the public site, Nov 4, 2026

entries.body: Donor records (about 4,200 donors, gift history, home addresses) live in a donor-management service. Six staff have accounts; the development director administers it.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: The donor-management service's own sign-in protection, export limits and alerts on bulk exports.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: The volunteer-scheduling app shows every volunteer the full roster of about 60 active volunteers, with names, mobile numbers and shift history.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: volunteer view of the scheduling app, Nov 2, 2026

entries.body: The scheduling app lets its administrator limit roster fields by role; the setting has never been changed from its default.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: Client intake (households served) is written on paper at the pantry window and keyed weekly into a spreadsheet on the NAS; there is no online client portal.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: The warehouse router forwards an inbound port to the NAS, and the NAS's web admin login page answers from the internet.
entries.label: VERIFIED
entries.source: external port check from a phone off the warehouse network, Nov 3, 2026

entries.body: The forward was set up in 2024 by a former volunteer so the warehouse lead could check stock levels from home. No record says who approved it.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: The NAS's firmware version and whether its automatic security updates are on.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: The NAS has one admin account, whose password is shared by the three warehouse shift leads.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: Whether the warehouse router's own admin page is reachable from the internet.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: The warehouse camera streams to its maker's cloud viewer, which its settings do not allow turning off; the viewer account is registered to the warehouse lead's personal email.
entries.label: VERIFIED

entries.body: Staff use 11 food-bank-owned Windows laptops signed in with Microsoft 365 accounts, updated by Windows Update on its default schedule; three part-time staff use personal laptops.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: Whether staff reach the NAS from home by any route other than the forwarded port.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: The NAS holds the warehouse inventory spreadsheet, the weekly client-intake spreadsheet, and 30 days of camera recordings.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: The NAS syncs its shares nightly to a consumer cloud-backup service; the sync mirrors changes and deletions.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: How many earlier versions the cloud-backup service keeps, and whether the NAS has snapshots turned on.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: Purview audit is on by default for the tenant and keeps 180 days of events on this licence.
entries.label: ON RECORD
entries.source: operations manager's records (from the licence documentation; not checked in the tenant)

entries.body: No SIEM or log collection exists, and no sign-in or audit records are kept outside the tenant.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: The board approved a one-page incident sheet naming the volunteer IT lead as responder and the operations manager as decision-maker, with the order of calls: payment processor, bank, insurer.
entries.label: VERIFIED

entries.body: Drivers and pantry volunteers use their own phones for the scheduling app and a group text thread; no device rules apply to them.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: The volunteer IT lead uses Global Administrator from a personal laptop and phone, and is available evenings and weekends.
entries.label: ON RECORD

entries.body: Which volunteers, past and present, know the donations@ password.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: Second-factor registration across staff accounts.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: App permissions and the user consent setting in the tenant.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: What the former managed IT provider connected to the tenant.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: NAS firmware and update state.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: Whether the router's admin page is exposed.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: Two-step sign-in on the CMS administrator accounts.
entries.label: UNKNOWN

entries.body: Version history kept by the cloud-backup service.
entries.label: UNKNOWN
